scope: Direct original and shared kernels, 4800 combinations across widths1,2,3,17,34,94; finite moderate/random-exponent, random-bit and exceptional inputs. Exact-sized heap allocations checked by ASan/UBSan. Leak checking disabled because runtime environment uses ptrace. Different NaN sign/payload bits in already-rejected state are classified separately; every other retained/scratch byte and status must match.
initial_strict_comparison: First strict byte comparison rejected n17 mixed exceptional case trial54: original R[1]=-NaN, shared R[1]=+NaN, both status=-1. Comparator revised solely to classify pairs of NaNs on rejected cases; implementation unchanged.
